source: Google Search Console Web performance export, page indexing, Core Web Vitals, links and manual actions reports

authority_and_experience.core_web_vitals: Not enough Chrome UX Report usage data for mobile or desktop in the last 90 days

interpretation: The report contains eleven days with impressions. It is too early and too small to describe a durable ranking or CTR trend.

The observed commercial query group usually appears well below the first results page. Low rank and limited authority are the immediate visibility constraints; zero clicks does not yet demonstrate a snippet problem.
Technical crawl controls are not the main property-wide blocker: 22 pages are indexed, the sitemap is successful, public pages are indexable and no manual action is present.

The site has almost no independent external-link evidence. Authentic business citations, professional profiles, permissioned work and relevant editorial references require business-owner activity and cannot be created as technical markup.
Website-development demand is not established by this sample: its mapped service page has one impression. Keep its intent stable and collect more completed data.
implemented_follow_up: Add crawlable sitewide footer links to the website-development and technical-SEO service pages.
Link the technical-SEO service directly to an editable audit review worksheet.
Add verified sales contact details to Organization structured data without claiming an unverified LocalBusiness address.
Add accurate article publication dates as sitemap lastmod values while omitting unverifiable dates for static pages.
Preserve existing titles, H1s and canonical ownership because the query sample does not support a new landing page or title experiment.
limitations: Search Console reports can omit low-volume queries for privacy, so visible query rows do not sum to property totals.
Search Console data is delayed and groups dates in Pacific Time.
Average position is an aggregate observation, not a fixed rank or forecast.
The raw account export remains outside the repository; this file contains aggregate observations only.
Search visibility, AI citations and qualified enquiries are separate measures. No ranking, click or enquiry improvement is promised.
